# Miaustico BSP

> Miaustico (BSP) is a web app for practising the Spanish past tenses: the indefinido, the imperfecto and the pretérito perfecto. It is built for students learning Spanish. Each tense has its own cat character: Zas (indefinido), Mimo (imperfecto) and Javi Tostado (pretérito perfecto).

## What you can do

- Escribiendo…: type the correct verb form in real sentences, one tense at a time, with immediate feedback.
- Lío de tiempos: mixed-tense sessions where you choose which past tense each sentence needs.
- Battle: live multiplayer quizzes. Players join a room with a six-character code and see a scoreboard after every round.
- Theory lessons for each tense, a saved list of your mistakes to redo, daily challenges, streaks, levels and badges.

## Tenses covered

- Indefinido: finished actions at a specific past moment. Regular, semi-irregular and fully irregular verbs. Example: "Ayer comí paella con mis compañeros."
- Imperfecto: habits, descriptions and background in the past. Regular and irregular verbs. Example: "De pequeño, comía paella todos los domingos."
- Pretérito perfecto: past actions connected to the present (today, this week, ever). Example: "Hoy he comido paella en la cafetería."

## Accounts

Sign up with a username and a 4-digit PIN. No email address is needed. Practice content is only available after signing in.
